body.statement: For every \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) and every \(B\) satisfying the admissibility conditions in \(\mathrm{lem:graphical\mbox{-}replacement\mbox{-}preservation}\), there exists \(\widetilde\eta\in\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) such that \(A(\widetilde\eta)=A(\eta)\) and \(\mathcal O(\widetilde\eta)=\mathcal O(\eta)=\mathcal O\). Hence \(\widetilde\eta\) has the well-defined observational selected law \(P_{\widetilde\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\widetilde\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\) and, for every \(k\in[K]\), a faithful pooled law \(P_{\widetilde\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\); it preserves every adjacency and every unshielded collider on every full domain \(U_k\), including all \(\zeta_k\)-involving instances, and for every \(k\in[K]\) satisfies \(Z_k=T_k(\widetilde\eta)\cup((F_k(\widetilde\eta)\setminus T_k(\widetilde\eta))\cap A(\widetilde\eta))\). No equality between \(\kappa(\widetilde\eta)\) and \(\kappa(\eta)\) is required.
body.justification: This synthesis theorem supplies a fully specified replacement model with the same complete oracle signature and ancestral selected set.
body.gap: Published equivalence results do not prove existence of faithful selected-law realizations for a synchronized replacement specification.
body.consumer: It supplies valid whole-family witnesses for selected-selected circles in the sciPlex2 graph.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct a jointly faithful member of \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\); after such a member is available, all remaining conclusions follow from the proved graphical replacement lemma and the frozen definitions.
obligation.obstruction: The graphical replacement result fixes \(A\), every regime skeleton, and every unshielded collider, but membership in \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) additionally requires the unresolved faithful selected pooled laws.
obligation.attempted: Completed the downstream implication equation by equation from a hypothetical jointly faithful realization. This shows that no separate compatibility-fiber or indicator-neighborhood argument remains; the sole missing premise is the atomic-completeness certificate isolated for \(\mathrm{lem:simultaneous\mbox{-}faithful\mbox{-}realization}\).
obligation.partial_result:
Assume only for this conditional derivation that the unresolved realization step supplies \(\widetilde\eta\in\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) whose pooled laws are faithful.  Membership in \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\), by \(\mathrm{def:replacement\mbox{-}realization\mbox{-}fiber}\), gives
\[
 \bigl(G_0(\widetilde\eta),(T_k(\widetilde\eta))_{k=1}^{K}\bigr)
 =\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B).
\]
The conclusion of \(\mathrm{lem:graphical\mbox{-}replacement\mbox{-}preservation}\) then yields
\[
 A(\widetilde\eta)=A(\eta)
\]
and, for every \(k=0,\ldots,K\), equality of the skeleton and unshielded-collider signature of \(M_k(\widetilde\eta)\) and \(M_k(\eta)\) on the whole domain \(U_k\).  Because the proposed realization has positive selection probability, \(P_{\widetilde\eta}^{(0)}\) is defined.  Membership in \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) already includes membership in \(\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}\), and the realization lemma supplies its pooled-law faithfulness explicitly.  Therefore \(\mathrm{def:oracle\mbox{-}signature}\) gives, component by component,
\[
 \mathcal O(\widetilde\eta)
 =\bigl(\operatorname{skel}(M_k(\widetilde\eta)),
          \operatorname{UC}(M_k(\widetilde\eta))\bigr)_{k=0}^{K}
 =\mathcal O(\eta)=\mathcal O.
\]
It follows from \(\mathrm{def:compatibility\mbox{-}fiber}\) that \(\widetilde\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\).  Finally, the last conclusion of \(\mathrm{lem:graphical\mbox{-}replacement\mbox{-}preservation}\) gives, for each \(k\in[K]\),
\[
 Z_k=T_k(\widetilde\eta)
 \cup\bigl((F_k(\widetilde\eta)\setminus T_k(\widetilde\eta))
            \cap A(\widetilde\eta)\bigr).
\]
No step uses \(\kappa(\widetilde\eta)=\kappa(\eta)\).  Hence every conclusion of the target follows formally from the graphical replacement lemma once the jointly faithful member exists; the only unproved implication is existence of that member.
